name: TMS OS Platform V14.0.2 — MariaDB Data Recovery & User Fallback
notes: Fixes mariadbd immediate crash on some devices: auto-reinitialize damaged data directory (mariadb-install-db), retry loop, socket auto-detection, and mariadbd-safe --user= fallback when the default mysql user cannot write pid files.
features: Robust Android/Termux LAN IPv4 discovery with multiple fallbacks
Never publishes 127.0.0.1 as a LAN address
Short direct LAN URL using Wi-Fi IP and each website port
Optional short .lan name through downloadable hosts file
sslip.io retained only as an optional advanced URL when a valid LAN IP exists
Unified Core V13.0 service and queue architecture retained
